P. -कल्पयति (inf. -कल्पयितवै, ŚBr. iv, 5, 2, 2) to prepare, make ready, equip; to procure, bring near, fetch, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; Lāṭy.; MBh. &c.; to allot, assign, MBh.; R.; Yājñ.; Kathās.; to put or set up, turn towards; to arrange, BhP.; Pañcat.; Prab.; to impart, communicate, BhP.; to assume, suppose, Sāh.
a: उपकॢप् — {c1c} A. 1 To be fit for; तत्रेदमुपकल्पते Bhāg. --2 To be prepared or ready (at hand); आसनेषूपकॢप्तेषु Ms. 3. 208, 8. 333. --3 To result in, serve as, lead to (with dat.); वार्यपि श्रद्धया दत्तमक्षयायोपकल्पते Ms. 3. 202. --4 To become, take a (particular) form or shape. --Caus. 1 To prepare, get ready, equip; रथं Ve. 2. --2 To appoint, assign, allot; उपकल्पितं पशुं Pt. 1; U. 2; Y. 1. 109. --3 To vow, promise; देवतोपकल्पित Pt. 4. --4 To set up, exhibit. --5 To render (homage), communicate. --6 To bring near, fetch. --7 To assume, take.

v: tri॰ upa--kfpa--kta । 1 niyate 2 vinyaste 3 upaBogAyasamarTe ca ।
m: उप-कॢप्त mfn. ready, prepared, ŚBr.; AitBr.; KātyŚr.; Mn. &c.
equipped, adapted, fitted for, brought near, MBh.; R. &c.
produced, formed, BhP.
a: उपकॢप्त — p. p. 1 Brought near, at hand. --2 Ready, prepared. --3 Fitted for, adapted to. --4 Formed, produced.

v: tri॰ upa + kzi--kta tasya na, dIrGaSca । 1 apacayaprApte 2 sakAryyAdyasAmarTyaM prApte ca ।
m: उप-क्षीण mfn. exhausted, consumed, KātyŚr.
absorbed, lost in Comm. on BṛĀrUp.
vanished, disappeared, Sāh.; Kathās.
a: उपक्षीण — p. p. 1 Decayed, exhausted, consumed, disappeared. --2 Powerless.

m: उप-क्षपयितृ mfn. (fr. the Caus.), one who destroys, a destroyer, Sāy. on RV.
उप-√ क्षर् P. -क्षरति, to flow or stream towards, RV. i, 124, 4; v, 62, 4; AitBr.; to pour over, TBr.
उप-क्षत्र m. N. of a king, VP.

v: pu॰ upa + kzi--ac । 1 apacaye hAnO । sAmIpyAdO avyayI॰ । 2 nivAsasamIpAdO, avya॰ । 2 upagataH kzayam atyA॰ sa॰ । 3 kzayaM prApte tri॰ । tatpuruze upAddvyackatvAdantodAttatA ।
m: 1. उप-क्षय (for 2. See col. 2) m. ‘a secondary or intermediate destruction of the world’, N. of Śiva [Nīlak.], MBh. xii, 10368.
2. उप-क्षय (for 1. See col. 1) m. decrease, decline, decay, waste, Hit. Comm. on VS. &c.
a: उपक्षय — a. Decayed, wasted. --यः 1 Waste, decay, loss. --2 Expenditure. --यं ind. Near the abode.

v: pu॰ upa + kzipa--BAve GaY । 1 Akzepe, “karRanAsAcCedopakzepaBIzitAByAm” daSaku॰ । 2 samIpe nikzepaRe ca ।
m: उप-क्षेप m. throwing at
threatening, L.
mention, allusion, hint, Sāh.; Kathās.; Daśar.; Viddh. &c.
poetical or figurative style in composition, W.
a: उपक्षेपः — 1 Throwing at, hurling. --2 Mention, allusion, hint, suggestion; कार्योपक्षेपमादौ तनुमपि रचयन् Mu. 4. 3; दारुणः खलूपक्षेपः पापस्य Ve. 5. --3 A threat, specific mention or charge; कर्णनासाच्छेदोपभीषिताभ्यां Dk. 61. --4 Commencement; उपाय˚ M. 3. --5 Poetical or figurative style (Wilson).

v: na॰ upa + kzipa--lyuw । SUdrasvAmikAnnasya vipragfhe pAkArTaM samarpaRe । “upakzepaRaDarmeRa yattu pAcayate dvijEH । aBojyaM tadBavedannam” SAmba॰ pu॰ । “upakzepaRaDarmeRa SUdrasvAmikAnnasya pAkArTaM brAhmaRagfhe samarpaRarUpeReti” kalpataruH । 2 samarpaRamAtre ca ।
m: उप-क्षेपण n. throwing at or down, L.
allusion, hint, suggestion, Sāh.
putting a Śūdra's food into a Brāhman's house (where it is cooked), Śāmbu-purāṇa (T.)
a: उपक्षेपणं — 1 Throwing or casting down. --2 Accusing, charging; ˚धर्मः = शूद्रस्वामिकामान्नस्य पाकार्थं ब्राह्मणगृहे समर्पणं Śabdak.

s: puM, (upakzepaRarUpo DarmmaH .) SUdrasvAmikAnnasya pAkArTaM brAhmaRagfhe samarpaRam । iti SudDitattve kalpataruH ॥

m: उप-क्षेपक mfn. alluding, suggesting
See अर्थोपक्षेपक.
उप-क्षेतृ mfn. one who dwells or stays near at, RV. iii, 1, 16.
a: उपक्षेतृ — a. One who draws near; or one who dwells near, attached to.

m: 1. उप-√ 1. क्षि Pass. -क्षीयते, to waste away, decay, be consumed or exhausted, TBr.
2. उप-√ 2. क्षि P. -क्षेति (RV.; 3. pl. -क्षियन्ति, AV. iv, 30, 4; RV.; Pot. 1. pl. -क्षयेम, AV. xix, 15, 4) to stay or dwell near or at, abide, dwell on (lit. and fig.), RV.; AV.
a: उपक्षि — {c1c} P. or pass. 1 To waste away, decay, be exhausted, disappear. --2 ({c2c} {c6c} P.) To dwell near (Ved.).

m: उप-√ क्षिप् P. -क्षिपति, to throw at, hurl against, BhP.; Sāh.; to beat, strike, ŚBr.; to strike with words, insult, accuse, insinuate, R.; to allude, hint at, Sāh.; Mṛcch.; Daś.; to speak of, describe, define, Sāh.; Sarvad.; to commence, set about (a work), Mall.
a: उपक्षिप् — {c6c} P. 1 To throw at, cast on, hurl against; वपुषि वधाय तत्र तव शस्त्रमुपक्षिपतः Māl. 5. 31; to direct; त्वयि उपक्षिप्त आत्मा M. 2; to entrust, assign; M. 3. --2 To insult, upbraid, accuse, charge with; परस्परं वाग्भिरुपक्षिपंति Rām. --3 To throw out (a hint), hint, indicate, put forth, adduce; छन्नं कार्यमुपक्षिपंति Mk. 9. 3; इति उपक्षिप्तमनेन Mu. 1; Māl. 1. --4 To throw down. --5 To commence, introduce, set on foot, begin; उपक्षिप्तमनेन किमपि Mu. 1; K. 162; Dk. 59; उपक्षिप्तो भित्तिबंधः M. 5.

v: tri॰ upa + kzi--kvip । samIpanivAsini । “yasya te agne anye agnaya upakzitI vayA iva” f॰ 8, 19, 33 ।
m: उप-क्षित् mfn. dwelling near
clinging to, adhering, RV. viii, 19, 33.
a: उपक्षित् — a. Ved. 1 Dwelling near. --2 Clinging or attached to.

m: उप-क्षित See अन्-उपक्षित.
उप-क्षुद्र mfn. some what small, TāṇḍyaBr.
